description:
Check how a prefix is registered across core TLDs, returning per-TLD status and aggregate counts.

Related: bulk_tld, available.
name: tld_check

cctlds_count.description: Number of ccTLDs with this prefix registered

count.description: Total number of TLDs with this prefix registered

error.description: Error message when success is false

gtlds_count.description: Number of gTLDs with this prefix registered

tlds.description: Status of core TLDs (com, net, org, io, ai, de). Values: registered, for_sale, expiring, or might_available

title: Cross-TLD Registration Check
